description: Personal data is kept for longer than necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Data should be retained only as long as needed and then securely deleted or anonymized.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data storage systems. Includes databases, file systems, backups, archives, and any persistent storage of personal data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of retention policies, data lifecycle management, and automated deletion mechanisms. Assess whether retention periods are defined and enforced.
